Definition: from the base of G5596; to supply with bits, i.e. (generally) to nourish:--(bestow to) feed.
BiblicalUsage: Psomizo means to supply with bits, to feed, to nourish. Paul says, If thine enemy hunger, feed him, if he thirst, give him drink, for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head. And, Though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor, and have not charity, it profiteth me nothing.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that feeding my enemy is the hardest command in the Bible, because it asks my hands to do what my heart has not yet learned.
